config.label: Path to a file holding the agent's session private key (0x + 64 hex, chmod 600)
config.description: Path to a file holding the agent's session private key (0x + 64 hex, chmod 600). The key can trade and cancel for the account but never withdraw.

config.label: The owner (trading) account the session key acts for
config.description: The owner (trading) account the session key acts for. Defaults to the session key's own address.

config.label: Optional owner key file; unlocks withdraw, deposit from the owner wallet, authorize_session and register_agent
config.description: Optional owner key file; unlocks withdraw, deposit from the owner wallet, authorize_session and register_agent. Keep it off shared machines.

config.label: Quote service override (default per chain: https://agent-api
config.description: Quote service override (default per chain: https://agent-api.hedgehood.io on mainnet, https://testnet-agent-api.hedgehood.io on the testnet)

config.label: Indexer override (default per chain: https://agent-index
config.description: Indexer override (default per chain: https://agent-index.hedgehood.io on mainnet, https://testnet-agent-index.hedgehood.io on the testnet)

config.label: x402 deposit gateway override (default per chain: https://agent-pay
config.description: x402 deposit gateway override (default per chain: https://agent-pay.hedgehood.io on mainnet, https://testnet-agent-pay.hedgehood.io on the testnet)

config.label: "false" makes write tools broadcast by default (they still need confirm: true)
config.description: "false" makes write tools broadcast by default (they still need confirm: true). Default true: simulate only.
